title: Central charges $C_J$ and $C_T$ in QED$_d$-GNY model and scalar QED$_d$
summary: We compute the leading-order $1/N$ corrections to the central charges $C_J$ and $C_T$ in the conformal QED$_d$-Gross-Neveu-Yukawa (GNY) model and the scalar QED$_d$ in $d$ dimensions. The scaling dimensions of the lowest adjoint bilinear scalars are obtained to order $O(1/N)$ for general $d$. In $d=3$, the $U(1)$ Abelian gauge theory possesses a topological $U(1)$ global symmetry, and we evaluate the central charge $C_J^{\text{top}}$ of the topological symmetry current to subleading order in the $1/N$ expansion.
